source: independent judge (grok, disposable worktree, no access to the verdict file)
why: Judge verdicts are otherwise written by the same agent that wrote the code. This run exists to produce dissent that self-review structurally cannot.
adjudication: UNADJUDICATED — each FAIL must be verified by hand before it is treated as real, and each one that turns out to be wrong must be recorded as wrong.

verdicts.note: HomePage uses short plain effects and halfMonthInWindow/monthToHalfMonths (HomePage.tsx:109-114, 263-270, 16-18). halfMonth helpers are single-expression branches (halfMonth.ts:44-49, 60-68). plantable/grid are Zod safeParse then thin handlers (plantable.ts:19-28, grid.ts:18-27). YearGrid cell mark mapping (YearGrid.tsx:107-122) is nested ternaries but readable at a glance without a decode comment.

fetchHealth (api.ts:65-67) is exported with zero production callers (only definition site in the app tree). halfMonthToMonth (halfMonth.ts:108-111) has no production caller — only halfMonth.test.ts:68-70. functions/lib/gridMath.ts is a single-function module reimplementing expandHalfMonthRange already exported from halfMonth.ts:90-101; grid.ts:5,45 imports the Worker copy instead of the shared helper — an extra layer with no distinct responsibility.

expandHalfMonthRange is implemented twice (halfMonth.ts:90-101 and gridMath.ts:7-16); grid.ts:5,45 uses the local copy while dates.ts already re-exports halfMonth for Workers. AssistantBodySchema (assistant.ts:57-60) duplicates AssistantRequestSchema (schemas.ts:239-242) and is not imported from schemas. AssistantFiltersSchema is defined twice (schemas.ts:246-250 vs assistant.ts:63-69); assistant-shape tests import the local one (assistant-shape.test.ts:4).

Git was not run (task forbids it). Product surface is scoped to the planting calendar ticket: App.tsx:17-28 routes are home, grid, crop detail, legal, 404; functions/api covers health/zone/zones/plantable/grid/crops/assistant only — no drive-by auth, unrelated CRUD, or extra product domains.

Boundary validation uses Zod: plantable PlantableQuerySchema.safeParse (plantable.ts:19-28), grid FilterQuerySchema (grid.ts:18-27), crops CropsQuerySchema (crops.ts:12-18), zones ZonesQuerySchema (zones.ts:14-19). POST assistant uses readJsonBody + schema then AssistantFiltersSchema.safeParse on model output (assistant.ts:358-399; http.ts:130-146). schemas.ts defines PlantableQuerySchema/FilterQuerySchema/CropsQuerySchema/AssistantRequestSchema (185-242). Path id for crop detail is presence-checked before DB lookup (crops/[id].ts:16-19).

No TODO/FIXME/stub security markers in app TS/TSX (only vitest stubGlobal in theme.test.ts). Assistant fails closed when DB/AI missing (assistant.ts:332-356), on rate-limit check failure (344-351), model failure/empty (372-387), invalid JSON/filters (389-399), and empty grounded answer (403-405). Rate limit uses real D1 counters and fail-closed missing-IP bucket (rateLimit.ts:10-22). Middleware forces non-JSON /api/* to 404 JSON (_middleware.ts:23-28).

groundFilters production branches are asserted (assistant-shape.test.ts:192-317: half_month, method, crop, empty). plantable/grid 400 validation and q-narrowing behavior tested (plantable.test.ts:64-173, grid.test.ts:64-151). Crop guide present/null asserted (crops/[id].test.ts:107-136; acceptance.spec.ts:114-141). Search fail-closed UI asserted (acceptance.spec.ts:352-390). Query schema calendar-invalid dates and assistant message bounds covered (schemas.test.ts:93-141).

Tests assert observable outcomes and error branches, not private structure: plantable cards/viewport for fixed date (acceptance.spec.ts:44-71), method filter changes counts/marks (156-199), search failure shows role=alert not empty grid (352-390), citation hrefs (96-128). groundFilters asserts crop sets and answer text (assistant-shape.test.ts:199-317). halfMonthInWindow wrap/non-wrap behavior (halfMonth.test.ts:31-57). crops/[id] asserts 400/404/200 bodies. Mocks sit at DB/API boundaries (vi.mock db in plantable/grid/assistant tests).

Home return is CompactHeader + HalfMonthTimeline + PlantableHero + AssistantPanel + YearGrid with state owned on the page (HomePage.tsx:276-323). GridPage owns filters/load and composes Filters + YearGrid (GridPage.tsx:45-68). About/Contact/Terms/Privacy are thin LegalPage wrappers (AboutPage.tsx:9-40, ContactPage.tsx:9-16, TermsPage.tsx:9-16; LegalPage.tsx:30-55). PlantableHero has loading/error/empty/success (PlantableHero.tsx:67-97); YearGrid separates loading/error/searchError/empty/table (YearGrid.tsx:28-82); LiveSearch has error/loading/empty/results (LiveSearch.tsx:226-267); AssistantPanel treats empty answer as error with role=alert (AssistantPanel.tsx:109-123, 200-208); CropDetail has loading/error/guide-missing/no-windows (CropDetailPage.tsx:36-76, 129-136). FAIL: useZone computes error (useZone.tsx:66-68, 85) but ZoneSelector only destructures zone/zones/loading/setZone (ZoneSelector.tsx:30) and never renders error or retry — on /api/zones failure the control is only disabled when zones.length===0 (ZoneSelector.tsx:160) while Layout falls back to en.appTagline (Layout.tsx:39-41), so a zone-list failure paints as quiet empty chrome rather than an explicit error state.
